title: The Dye Vat
description: A copper vat of indigo dye steams beside the road; loose thread floats on the surface, waiting to be dipped or skimmed.

choices.text: Immerse one owned pool card in the dye (spend 3 scraps; it becomes its authored + version)
Skim the dyed thread from the surface (+1 scrap)
Leave the vat to its own colours
